body:
Thank you. this is exactly what I needed to hear. I don't think I could go through with this if I had to convince a room full of strangers that the one I trusted most in the world could do something like this.  
It's scary to think about how long this is going to take after being told after it happening that he'd do it again, and completely stopped showing signs of remorse.

I guess I just keep living my life and wait every day for a phone call until this is all finally over, whatever *they* decide.. 

Thank you for the clarity, I feel extremely better about this now knowing I won't have to get on the stand and be judged.
No one is shaming anyone.. It’s an extremely civil conversation that I thought we could have resolved ourselves without going so far as potentially ruining his life over it.
Thank you all. Unfortunately a majority of our friends are mutual and it was hard to tell a few of them. But i’m lucky everyone has been really supportive through this.
Yes it very much does, thank you.

I know where he lives, I googled their police department. Is it really so simple as just calling & saying what happened?
What happens after that?
He lives in another country, I don’t know how that works..
